name: The CC-List Clerk
effect: Boosting this layer-6 neuron makes the model treat every request as an email it can't send yet, so it asks who should receive it or be CC'd and never answers the question.
source: Found by the overnight screen of all 294,912 neurons; blind judges told it apart from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs (q=1.0e-06).
